title: Strength.
officialText:
Concrete shall be proportioned to provide an average compressive strength in accordance with Section
1905.3, and shall satisfy the durability criteria of Section 1904. Concrete shall be produced to minimize the frequency of
strengths below f' in compliance with Section 1905.6.3.3. For concrete designed and constructed in accordance with this
c
chapter, f' shall not be less than 2,500 psi (17.22 MPa). No maximum specified compressive strength shall apply unless
c
restricted by a specific provision of this code or ACI 318.
